'''Gold Two''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the second member of Gold Squadron. There were multiple [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Gold Two.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Gold Two (Muunilinst)|clone trooper pilot]] flew a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] Gold Two for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]].<ref name="CW10" />

While [[Trihexalon attack on Coruscant|defending]] the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] from a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Trihexalon]] attack, "Gold Two", a [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Group]] [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], voiced an appreciation for the predictability of the enemy's [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]].<ref name="Kinect" />

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tiree/Legends|Tiree]]<ref name="CCGT">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Tiree}}</ref> used the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] when he flew with [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Tiree was killed in the assault against the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="ANH" />

In the lead up to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] flew as Gold Two for a [[Mission to meet Bothan delegation|mission to meet with a delegation]] from the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]], the [[Battle of Azzameen Station|recapture of his family's space station]], the rescue of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] spies from [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]], and while escorting the [[Defiance Task Force|''Defiance'']] and [[Independence task force|''Independence'' groups]] to the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Rebel staging ground near Sullust]].<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

During the [[Second Battle of Endor]], an [[Alliance of Free Planets]] pilot using the call sign Gold Two was ordered to provide cover for a squadronmate flying as [[Gold Four/Legends|Gold Four]].<ref name="SW100" />

During a simulation exercise to qualify for [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles's]] [[Wraith Squadron|new squadron]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Thakwaash]] pilot [[Hohass Ekwesh]] used the call sign of Gold Two.<ref name="XWWS" />
